text:
maria_sales: Hey team — Zenith POC is moving to contract. Legal sent back the MSA + DPA with a few redlines. They also want PO-first and CFO signature. Can we confirm routing and payment terms so I can prepare the DocuSign envelope?

jordan_legal: skimmed the redlines: main asks are data residency language, subprocessor list, audit rights, and a 99.9% SLA carveout they added. Also flagged export control clause. I think we can accept some DPA changes but not expanded audit window. Need to confirm who signs on their side (name/email). :thinking_face:

alex_k: Customer is asking for 12mo term, monthly invoices. Pricing agreed in SOW: $102k ARR (monthly $8,500). They want net60. Can finance flex to net45 or net60?

helen_finance: Our standard is net30. For net45/net60, need approval from finance lead. If they provide a PO before contract execution, we can accept net45 as a one-off. Otherwise we need prepay or net30.

sam_ops: For the POC portion we can include a one-time credit for dedicated capacity (up to $5k) and keep the onboarding window. That won't affect MSA but worth noting on the order form.

maria_sales: Order form draft (will attach to envelope):
```
Order Form (draft)
- Customer: Zenith Labs, Inc.
- Product: Redwood Hosted Inference (Standard)
- Term: 12 months
- Start: upon execution
- Billing: Monthly $8,500 (total $102,000)
- PO required by 2026-05-01 or funds secured
- Signer requested: Lisa Monroe, CFO (lisa.monroe@zenith.com)
- Procurement contact: procurement@zenith.com
```

jordan_legal: That looks fine. Routing recommendation: 1) Zenith CFO (signature) -> 2) Zenith Procurement (PO upload) -> 3) Redwood AE (alex_k) as countersignature -> 4) Redwood Exec/Legal if order_value > $100k. Since this is $102k, we need exec sign-off (Sasha or Malik can sign). I'll prepare a redlined MSA and include tracked changes for the DPA.

alex_k: Do we have an approved exec signer? Sasha is out this week. Malik is available but prefers to review first. Can we set the envelope to require exec sign only if value > $100k so it routes automatically?

helen_finance: We can do conditional signers in DocuSign but need the envelope configured properly. If you get me the final order form I can provisionally approve net45 (subject to PO).

maria_sales: @jordan_legal — please confirm whether the redlines are "accept with edits" or "require negotiation" for these clauses. I want to avoid another round.

jordan_legal: Accept with edits on DPA (update subprocessors list + retention period). Negotiation needed on SLA uptime percentage and audit scope. I'll mark those two as negotiable and include fallback language.

docsign-bot: DocuSign envelope created by maria_sales: https://docusign.example/ENV-987654321 (routing set: CFO -> Procurement -> AE -> Exec conditional)

maria_sales: Sending now but holding final send until finance confirms net45. @helen_finance can you confirm by EOD? If so I'll route this afternoon. :+1:

helen_finance: Confirmed provisional net45 approval if PO is uploaded within 10 business days of execution. I'll follow up with billing team to expect Zenith PO.

alex_k: Thanks everyone. I'll ping Zenith to confirm signer details and PO timeline, and post back when they confirm Lisa Monroe email.

maria_sales: Perfect — I'll attach the redlined MSA from jordan_legal to the envelope and set the conditional exec signer. Thanks all.

sam_ops: Note: ops will tag the POC as "prod-ready" after signatures + PO so infra can schedule migration.

maria_sales: Closing loop — will update thread after send.
